2025-06-15T01:23:36.9285713Z <pr_title>
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9286266Z Simplify CI: consolidate bloated workflows and add immediate wheel access
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9286936Z </pr_title>
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9287115Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9287251Z <pr_description>
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9288605Z This PR addresses the CI complexity and reliability issues by dramatically simplifying the workflow structure and providing multiple access methods for package installation.
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9289932Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9290070Z ## Problem
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9290579Z The repository had **6 CI workflow files** with significant redundancy:
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9291249Z - `build-artifacts.yaml`
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9291676Z - `build-packages-dev.yaml` 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9292284Z - `build-packages-prod.yaml`
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9292637Z - `build-packages-staging.yaml`
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9292917Z - `create-release.yaml`
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9293148Z - `tools.yaml`
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9293282Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9293751Z This created maintenance complexity and CI reliability issues, making it difficult to successfully build and access wheel artifacts.
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9294336Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9294413Z ## Solution
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9294528Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9294633Z ### 1. Consolidated CI Workflows
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9295197Z **Reduced from 6 to 3 focused workflows** (50% reduction):
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9295472Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9295992Z - **`build-and-deploy.yaml`**: Unified workflow that builds once and deploys to appropriate environments based on triggers
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9296875Z - **`commit-wheels.yaml`**: Fallback workflow that commits wheels directly to the repository when CI builds succeed
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9297564Z - **`tools.yaml`**: Unchanged, handles build tools and container management
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9297887Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9297989Z ### 2. Multiple Installation Methods
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9298290Z Users can now install packages via:
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9298495Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9298584Z **One-line installer:**
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9298819Z ```bash
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9299402Z curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sgbaird/opentrons-python-packages/main/install.sh | bash -s -- pandas
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9299965Z ```
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9300064Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9300155Z **Direct wheel download:**
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9300381Z ```bash
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9301038Z curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sgbaird/opentrons-python-packages/main/wheels/pandas-1.5.0-cp310-cp310-linux_armv7l.whl -o /tmp/pandas.whl
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302024Z pip install /tmp/pandas.whl
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302349Z ```
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302445Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302599Z **CI artifacts and releases** (when CI runs successfully)
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302848Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9302951Z ### 3. Immediate Package Access
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9303546Z Added pre-built wheel files directly to the repository in the `wheels/` directory, so packages are immediately available even if CI fails.
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9304278Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9304363Z ## Key Benefits
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9304617Z - **Simplified maintenance**: 50% fewer workflow files
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9305116Z - **Eliminated redundancy**: Single build logic instead of duplicated across multiple files
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9305639Z - **Improved reliability**: Multiple fallback access methods
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9306127Z - **Better user experience**: Immediate access to packages via curl/pip as requested
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9306677Z - **Clear documentation**: Added `CI-SIMPLIFICATION.md` explaining the changes
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9306995Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9307380Z The solution directly addresses the "bloated" CI concern while ensuring reliable package access through multiple channels.
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9307864Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9307945Z Fixes #11.
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9308049Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9308052Z 
2025-06-15T01:23:36.9308139Z </pr_description>
